purpose: Validate the mass-relocation method on ON_MEMU_O.MDI only before touching mission MDIs.

stage40b_diagnosis.problem_1: Stage40B patched every MDI before the ON_MEMU relocation method had been visually proven.
stage40b_diagnosis.problem_2: Its smoke test read the production font object before font initialization, so glyph_count=0/glyph_ptr=0 was a false failure signal.
stage40b_diagnosis.problem_3: Its main-menu success test still required English Options/Profile at the old Stage39R addresses even though Stage40B intentionally translated those values.
stage40b_diagnosis.result: The Stage40B ISO is not promoted. Stage40C restarts from the known-good Stage39U ISO and patches only ON_MEMU_O.
